Container.Name: P-StreamRec
Container.Overview: P-StreamRec is a self-hosted recorder for Chaturbate, CAM4, and m3u8/HLS live streams, with a web interface for discovery, following, live watch, recordings, password protection, optional account login, recording segmentation, and automatic MP4 conversion.
Container.Requires: For the best Chaturbate support, install FlareSolverr separately and set FLARESOLVERR_URL. If both containers are on a custom Docker network, http://flaresolverr:8191 is expected; on bridge networking, use the Unraid server IP and FlareSolverr port.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Stores the database, sessions, thumbnails, cookies, original TS recordings, and converted MP4 files.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used by the app, for example America/Toronto.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional password required to access the web interface.

Config.Name: Auto Record Users
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated usernames to monitor and record automatically.

Config.Name: Chaturbate Resolver
Config.Description: Enable Chaturbate stream resolution. Use true or false.

Config.Name: FlareSolverr URL
Config.Description: Optional FlareSolverr URL for Cloudflare bypass. Install FlareSolverr separately if needed.

Config.Name: Chaturbate Username
Config.Description: Optional Chaturbate username for Following sync and better stream quality.

Config.Name: Recording Segment Duration
Config.Description: Optional split interval in minutes. Use 0, 30, 60, or 90.

Config.Name: Recording Segment Size
Config.Description: Optional maximum TS segment size in MB. Use 0 to disable size-based splitting.

Config.Name: Auto Convert
Config.Description: Automatically convert completed TS recordings to MP4. Use true or false.

Config.Name: Keep TS Originals
Config.Description: Keep original TS files after MP4 conversion. Use true or false.

Config.Name: Provider Proxy URL
Config.Description: Optional outbound proxy for provider requests, such as http, https, socks4, or socks5.

Config.Name: No Proxy
Config.Description: Hosts that should bypass standard proxy environment variables.

Config.Name: Chaturbate Request Delay
Config.Description: Delay between Chaturbate requests, in seconds.
